testedTree.scope: The checked-in implementation was tested. Only evidence/docs were generated afterward.

environment.device: Desktop; mobile smoke is browser emulation, not Android/iPhone

changes: Exact normalized BigInt rational arithmetic, bounded decimal serialization and one final floor; no Infinity/NaN.
Twelve hands and played/scoring/active/held sets use stored order; ordinary points exclude kickers and disabled cards.
Six r2 character timings, voluntary once-per-stage touye wager, public preview with two possible scores and no live RNG argument.
Five existing definition IDs preserved with finite typed hooks; left-to-right operations, instance growth after score, depth 1/four extra card triggers, explicit cap events and 512-event diagnostics.
Explicit version routing through applyCommand and generic RunController, r2 schema 2/string scores/independent content hash. Duplicate commands and length-limit failures leave resources unchanged.
Removed default-all equipment and its dead export from r1; existing r1 score and balance expectations retained.

migration.kind: explicit rule upgrade per D02; not a bugfix that changes r1 expectations
differences: r1 has no ordinary rank chips; r2 ranks 2–10/JQK/A contribute 2–10/10/11 only on active scoring cards.
r2 base table and 12 types/levels differ from r1 nine-type table.
r1 combined additive/final groups and round; r2 per-phase ordered H/M and one floor.
r2 amo/erxiang/laohuan/azao/xiemu use the new characterScore predicates and amounts.
r1 touye consumes a forced random result each hand; r2 normally x1.15 without RNG, optional one hand x2 or x0.75.
r2 reward boundary in G10 uses 4+unused hands+interest+xiemu bonus; complete economy and shop flow remain R03.
migration.ui: Current website remains the r1 compatibility adapter. R02 r2 headless starts stage-ready; R03 adds inventory/discards/shop and enables the r2 user flow.

limitations: Physical Android Chrome/iPhone Safari and target-device performance NOT_RUN. User will validate Android only at key milestones and handles deployment.
Human core UX/benchmark/art approval NOT_RUN; no self-signoff.
R03 full shop/discard/persistent-deck interactions and r2 UI not implemented in this package.
R04 persistent checkpoints/cancellation remain open, including R00 F07. R05 FIT readability and full PNG preload remain open.
Only five production definitions; growth/retrigger/held hooks validated through explicit test fixtures, not a claimed 72-card catalog.
r2 numeric parameters/targets and six-role fairness are uncalibrated; unit passes do not certify balance.
Existing Vite large-chunk warning and two moderate Vitest advisories remain for R05/R06.
